_note: Synthetic example. A made up agency selling to made up software founders.
niche: founders of small B2B software companies
their_customers: heads of operations at mid sized logistics firms
outcome: demo calls with heads of operations who fit your target list
booked_call: a demo on the founder's calendar with a head of operations at a company on the agreed list

approval_step: you review the account list and the message set
